newsitem.title: SPAIN: Rate declines allow debt issue reduction - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Rate declines allow debt issue reduction - Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Friday that interest rate reductions in the last year will allow the Treasury to cut 1997 debt issuance by at least one-half point of gross domestic product.
In late 1996, the government had estimated issuance would be down 0.3 points in 1997 from 1996 because of rate reductions.

"The (reduction) now can and should be greater," Montoro said in an interview with Reuters. "Now we could talk about, given the achievement of growth perspectives, a reduction of (debt issuance) of at least a half-point of GDP."
Since then, official interest rates have come down even further, to stand at six percent, three full points beneath levels seen at the start of 1996. Long-term yields have also fallen dramatically.
